title: Local mass of a difference: M_W(Y) ≤ M_W(T) + M_W(S) when Y = T − S on forms supported in W
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U, W ⊆ ℝ^P be arbitrary sets, and T, S, Y ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (contract GeometricCurrentOn U n). Suppose Y(ω) = T(ω) − S(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) (TestFormOn U n) with tsupport ω ⊆ W. Then M_W(Y) ≤ M_W(T) + M_W(S) in [0, ∞], where M_W is the SimonGMT local mass massOn (Simon Ch. 6, 2.5): the supremum of ofReal(Z(ω)) over ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ W and Euclidean coefficient norm covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)) ≤ 1 for every x.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (T S Y : GeometricCurrentOn U n), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ W → Y ω = T ω - S ω) → Y.massOn W ≤ T.massOn W + S.massOn W
